intro: A big round of updates, most of them straight from your feedback — thank you!
title: What’s new in ToothOps

dictateAnywhere.title: Dictate from any page
dictateAnywhere.body: The button is now 🎤 Dictate. Talk through your findings from wherever you are — each one lands in the right place.

finalCheck.title: More accurate, with a final check
finalCheck.body: It catches findings split across pauses and your corrections. When you tap Stop it re-reads the whole recording and lists anything it wasn’t sure about under Needs review.

phones.title: Better on phones
phones.body: Dictation opens full screen and keeps your screen awake while you talk.

understandsMore.title: Understands more
understandsMore.body: “GE 3” for enlargement, pocket depths per root, the caudal maxillary block and radiographic findings.

pocketPerRoot.title: Pocket depth per root
pocketPerRoot.body: Charting → Customize → One per root. Multi-rooted teeth get a labelled box per root (M / D, or MB / MP / D).

severalTeeth.title: Set several teeth at once
severalTeeth.body: Click tooth numbers in the grid (Shift-click for a range), then set one score on all of them.

makeItYours.title: Make it yours
makeItYours.body: Every page has a Customize button: hide columns, choose what shows beside the teeth, what the Space key does, and more. Settings follow your account to every device.

radiographicFindings.title: Radiographic findings
radiographicFindings.body: A dedicated box on the Images page. It prints on the PDF above the treatment report.

anesthesia.title: Anesthesia
anesthesia.body: Caudal maxillary block added. Hide the blocks you don’t use, and save your usual anesthetic for one-tap entry.

skipRecheck.title: Skip the recheck field
skipRecheck.body: Don’t use recheck reminders? Patient → Customize → Hide the Recheck due field.

writeWithAi.title: ✨ Write with AI
writeWithAi.body: Drafts the opening summary and home care advice from the chart, using only what you charted. You review before printing.

customizeReport.title: Customize the report
customizeReport.body: Change its layout, wording and language right from the Owner Report page.

startsWhereLeft.title: Starts where you left off
startsWhereLeft.body: Opening ToothOps fresh shows My charts — unless today’s visit is still open — and today’s visit opens ready to edit.

sendFeedback.title: Send feedback in two taps
sendFeedback.body: Settings → Send feedback, or Feedback in the dictation panel (it can attach your transcript). It comes straight to us.
